entry.title: feat: cloud daily backup from AnkiWeb via GitHub Actions
entry.content:
feat: cloud daily backup from AnkiWeb via GitHub Actions

Adds a scheduled workflow (.github/workflows/anki-backup.yml) that runs
on GitHub's servers — works even when the Mac is off. It downloads the
collection from AnkiWeb using a stored sync token and commits the export
(download-only; never uploads).

- scripts/get_ankiweb_hkey.py: one-time local helper to mint the hkey
  token (password typed locally, never stored) for the ANKIWEB_HKEY /
  ANKIWEB_ENDPOINT repo secrets.
- scripts/anki_cloud_export.py: headless sync + per-deck JSON export,
  using SyncAuth(hkey) to avoid CI's password-login block.
- README: cloud setup is now the recommended path; the local launchd
  job is documented as an optional alternative and is no longer
  installed by default.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

entry.title: cards: full NeetCode 250 as story-front deck (18 category subdecks)
entry.content:
cards: full NeetCode 250 as story-front deck (18 category subdecks)

One story-front card per NeetCode 250 problem, authored to hide the
technique so the solver recognizes the pattern; backs give Maps to /
Model it / Approach & variations / Time / Space with reasoning.
Organized into deck "NeetCode 250" with a subdeck per category and a
markdown record per category under card-sets/NeetCode-250/.

Coverage verified: all 250 slugs present exactly once, 0 missing/dupes;
250 notes pushed to Anki, 0 failed.
